text: “国家队”率先出手护盘，稳市机制持续护航A股 第一财经记者获悉，证监会将于近日召开证券基金机构和上市公司代表座谈会，听取参会人员对促进资本市场稳定健康发展的意见建议。回顾此前股市关键时期，证监会均有组织市场主体召开座谈会的先例。此举亦被认为是向市场释放积极稳市信号的明确举动。
text_en: "National Team" takes lead in market stabilization, steady market mechanisms continue to support A-shares. First Financial reporters learned that the CSRC will soon hold a symposium with securities, fund firms, and listed companies to gather opinions on promoting stable and healthy capital market development. Historically, the CSRC has organized such symposiums with market entities during critical periods, seen as a clear move to send positive stability signals to the market.
